<thought>I will search for a retrosynthetic template that converts two aldehydes into a C‑C double bond (McMurry coupling). This matches the target and will allow a one‑step synthesis from two equivalents of p‑anisaldehyde, a cheap, commercially available reagent.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aldehydes"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
